newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks seen moving stronger.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks seen moving stronger.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to continue to rally on Monday in a follow-through of last week's bullish trend on Wall Street and at home, brokers said.
"We could trade in a wide range, 100 points plus or minus, but I think we will finish on the plus side," said Alistair Candlish, head of derivatives trading at Indosuez W.I. Carr.
The Hang Seng Index gained 341 points to close at an all-time high of 14,757.81 on Friday, and the Dow Industrials later rose 0.86 of a point to 7,331.04.
